description: Controls every audit must report on. Each control gets one state: VERIFIED, NOT_MET, UNVERIFIED, or NOT_APPLICABLE. A release-critical control that is UNVERIFIED (and not covered by a valid accepted risk) forces the ship gate to BLOCKED - INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE. A control missing from an audit is treated as UNVERIFIED.

controls.title: No live credentials or secrets are exposed in source, configuration, or client-delivered code
controls.applies_when: Always.
controls.verified_when: Credentials are loaded from the environment or a secret manager; tracked files, committed environment files, and client bundles contain only placeholders or public identifiers.
controls.static_limits: Git history, deployed artifacts, and CI logs are not inspected unless evidence is imported.

controls.title: Queries, commands, templates, file paths, and outbound URLs built from untrusted input are parameterized, escaped, or validated
controls.applies_when: The project builds database queries, shell commands, templates, file paths, or server-side requests from external input.
controls.verified_when: Each identified construction site uses parameterization, safe APIs, allowlists, or validation that the audit traced to the input source.
controls.static_limits: Dynamic or reflective construction may not be fully traceable statically.

controls.title: Untrusted data rendered into HTML or rich content is encoded by default and raw-HTML sinks are sanitized
controls.applies_when: The project renders HTML, markdown, or rich content that can include user or third-party data.
controls.verified_when: Templates or UI frameworks auto-escape, and every raw-HTML sink found is fed only trusted or sanitized content.
controls.static_limits: Content injected at runtime by third-party scripts is not visible statically.

controls.title: Inbound webhooks verify authenticity, reject stale or replayed events, and process idempotently
controls.applies_when: The project receives webhooks or callbacks from external services.
controls.verified_when: Signature or shared-secret verification occurs before processing, timestamps or event IDs prevent replay, and handlers are idempotent.
controls.static_limits: Provider-side configuration (registered endpoints, secret rotation) is not visible.

controls.title: Uploaded and served files are size- and type-validated, stored safely, and access-controlled
controls.applies_when: The project accepts uploads or serves user-provided files.
controls.verified_when: Size and content-type limits, safe storage paths or object keys, non-executable storage, and authorization on download are present.
controls.static_limits: Storage bucket policies managed outside the repository are not visible.

controls.title: CSRF protection, restrictive CORS, security headers, and HTTPS are configured for web surfaces
controls.applies_when: The project serves a web application or HTTP API.
controls.verified_when: Cookie-authenticated state changes are CSRF-protected, CORS allows only intended origins, and security headers are set.
controls.static_limits: Headers added by proxies or hosting platforms may not be visible.

controls.title: Errors and logs do not disclose secrets, stack traces, internal details, or personal data
controls.applies_when: The project runs as a service or application that logs or returns errors.
controls.verified_when: Production error handlers return generic messages and logging excludes credentials and personal data.
controls.static_limits: Log contents at runtime are not observed.

controls.title: Protected routes, APIs, and jobs require authentication enforced on the server
controls.applies_when: The project has functionality that should not be public.
controls.verified_when: Every protected entry point found is covered by server-side authentication middleware, guards, or provider-enforced policies.
controls.static_limits: Authentication enforced only by external gateways is not visible unless their configuration is in the repository.

controls.title: Credentials are handled safely: adaptive password hashing, single-use expiring reset tokens, or delegation to an identity provider
controls.applies_when: The project handles passwords, password resets, or account recovery itself.
controls.verified_when: Passwords use an adaptive hash (for example bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2, PBKDF2 with strong parameters) and reset tokens are random, single-use, and expiring; or an identity provider owns these flows.
controls.static_limits: Identity-provider configuration outside the repository is not visible.

controls.title: Sessions and tokens expire, are invalidated on logout and credential change, and use secure cookie attributes
controls.applies_when: The project issues sessions, cookies, or bearer tokens.
controls.verified_when: Expiry, invalidation paths, and Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite attributes (where cookies are used) are present.
controls.static_limits: Token lifetimes configured in external providers are not visible.

controls.title: Login, registration, and reset flows resist brute force and account enumeration
controls.applies_when: The project exposes login, registration, or reset flows.
controls.verified_when: Rate limiting or lockout and non-enumerating responses are present.
controls.static_limits: Edge or WAF rate limits are not visible.

controls.title: Authorization is enforced server-side for every protected action; client-side checks are not relied upon
controls.applies_when: The project serves more than one user or principal (for example a web application, API, or multi-user service) and gives them different roles, permissions, or access to user-specific data. Permission settings of a developer tool or its host, such as tool allow lists, are not authorization in this sense; application-security and AI controls cover them.
controls.verified_when: Server-side checks guard each protected action found; UI-only gating is not the sole control.
controls.static_limits: Policies enforced by external services are not visible unless configured in the repository.

controls.title: Object-level ownership and tenant checks protect reads and writes of user- or tenant-scoped records
controls.applies_when: The project stores data scoped to users, organizations, workspaces, or tenants.
controls.verified_when: Queries and handlers constrain records by the authenticated principal or tenant, or row-level policies enforce it.
controls.static_limits: Database policies applied outside the repository are not visible.

controls.title: Administrative and support functions require server-side administrative authorization
controls.applies_when: The project has administrative, support, or internal tooling functions.
controls.verified_when: Admin entry points check an administrative role or permission on the server.
controls.static_limits: Internal tools hosted elsewhere are not visible.

controls.title: Datastores and storage are not publicly accessible and client-direct access is restricted by policy
controls.applies_when: The project persists data or files.
controls.verified_when: Storage is private by default, and any client-direct database or storage access is restricted by row-level or bucket policies found in the repository.
controls.static_limits: Cloud console settings are not visible unless captured as infrastructure-as-code or imported evidence.

controls.title: Sensitive data is minimized, protected appropriately, and not exposed in responses or logs
controls.applies_when: The project processes personal, financial, health, or other sensitive data.
controls.verified_when: Responses and logs exclude sensitive fields and sensitive values are protected where stored.
controls.static_limits: Encryption at rest provided by hosting platforms is not visible unless configured in the repository.

controls.title: Account and data deletion exists and covers the data locations the project uses or describes
controls.applies_when: The project stores personal data about end users.
controls.verified_when: A deletion path removes or anonymizes the user's records, files, and derived data, and handles third-party copies, consistent with what documentation states.
controls.static_limits: Backup retention and third-party deletion behavior are usually not verifiable statically.

controls.title: Privacy disclosures match actual collection, tracking, sharing, and retention
controls.applies_when: The project collects personal data from end users.
controls.verified_when: A privacy disclosure exists and the collection, analytics, sharing, and retention observed in code agree with it.
controls.static_limits: Data flows in external systems are not visible.

controls.title: Retention periods are defined and implemented for data, logs, analytics, and backups
controls.applies_when: The project stores personal data or logs.
controls.verified_when: Retention settings or cleanup jobs match stated retention.
controls.static_limits: Retention configured in external services is not visible.

controls.title: Paid access is enforced server-side from verified provider state; client-supplied plan or status is never trusted
controls.applies_when: The project gates features or content behind payment or subscription.
controls.verified_when: Entitlement checks on the server derive from provider-verified records, not request parameters or client storage.
controls.static_limits: Provider dashboard configuration is not visible.

controls.title: Payment events are verified, idempotent, replay-safe, and handle failure, cancellation, and refund transitions
controls.applies_when: The project processes payment-provider events.
controls.verified_when: Signature verification, idempotent processing keyed on event IDs, and handlers for failed payment, cancellation, and refund are present.
controls.static_limits: Which events the provider sends depends on external configuration.

controls.title: Secret payment keys stay server-side and amounts are computed on the server
controls.applies_when: The project integrates a payment provider.
controls.verified_when: Only publishable keys reach clients and prices or amounts are determined server-side.
controls.static_limits: None beyond general secret-exposure limits.

controls.title: Dependencies are pinned through committed lockfiles and installed reproducibly
controls.applies_when: The project uses a package manager.
controls.verified_when: Lockfiles are committed and CI uses frozen or locked installs.
controls.static_limits: None.

controls.title: Known-vulnerability status of dependencies is established for the audited revision
controls.applies_when: The project has third-party dependencies.
controls.verified_when: Imported scanner output for the audited revision shows no unaddressed vulnerabilities, or each reported vulnerability is assessed.
controls.static_limits: Flight Check works offline and does not query vulnerability databases; this control stays UNVERIFIED unless scanner output is imported.

controls.title: Install scripts, build steps, and CI pipelines avoid dangerous patterns and pin external actions
controls.applies_when: The project has build scripts, install hooks, or CI configuration.
controls.verified_when: No unreviewed remote-script execution in builds; CI actions and images are pinned; CI credentials are scoped.
controls.static_limits: CI settings outside the repository are not visible.

controls.title: Third-party services are identifiable with their data flows, credential handling, and failure handling
controls.applies_when: The project integrates external services.
controls.verified_when: Each service found has server-side credentials, known data shared, and failure handling.
controls.static_limits: Contracts and data processing agreements are not visible.

controls.title: The project license is declared and third-party code and assets carry compatible licenses and attribution
controls.applies_when: The project is distributed or deployed publicly, or bundles third-party code or assets.
controls.verified_when: A license is declared and bundled assets and dependencies show licenses compatible with distribution, with required attributions.
controls.static_limits: Ownership of original assets and contractor agreements cannot be determined from files.

controls.title: Network exposure, administrative access, and preview or staging environments are restricted
controls.applies_when: The project is deployed or defines infrastructure.
controls.verified_when: Infrastructure definitions restrict exposure and previews do not use production data or credentials.
controls.static_limits: Infrastructure not defined in the repository is not visible.

controls.title: Production configuration disables debug and development features, enforces HTTPS, and separates environments
controls.applies_when: The project is deployable as a service or application.
controls.verified_when: Production settings disable debug modes and development endpoints, require HTTPS, and use environment-specific configuration and credentials.
controls.static_limits: Hosting platform settings are not visible unless captured in the repository.

controls.title: Public surfaces have rate limits, quotas, or abuse protection appropriate to their cost and risk
controls.applies_when: The project exposes public endpoints or costly operations.
controls.verified_when: Rate limiting, quotas, or equivalent protection is present on costly or abusable endpoints.
controls.static_limits: Edge protections are not visible.

controls.title: Persistent production data is backed up and restoration has been tested
controls.applies_when: The project stores persistent production data.
controls.verified_when: Backup configuration exists and imported evidence shows a successful restore test.
controls.static_limits: Restore testing is an operational fact; this control stays UNVERIFIED unless restore-test evidence is imported.

controls.title: External calls, jobs, and queues use timeouts, bounded retries, and idempotency
controls.applies_when: The project calls external services or runs background work.
controls.verified_when: Timeouts, retry limits, and idempotency are present at the integration points found.
controls.static_limits: Runtime behavior under failure is not observed.

controls.title: Error tracking, monitoring, and alerting are configured
controls.applies_when: The project runs as a deployed service or application.
controls.verified_when: Error tracking or monitoring is integrated and alerting is configured or documented.
controls.static_limits: Dashboards and alert routing outside the repository are not visible.

controls.title: Deployment and rollback procedures exist
controls.applies_when: The project is deployed.
controls.verified_when: Deployment configuration or runbooks describe how to roll back.
controls.static_limits: Whether rollback has been exercised is not visible.

controls.title: Automated tests cover authentication, authorization, payment, deletion, and other critical paths that exist
controls.applies_when: The project has critical flows such as authentication, authorization, payments, or deletion.
controls.verified_when: Tests exercising those flows exist, including negative cases for access control.
controls.static_limits: Whether tests pass is not known unless test results are imported.

controls.title: The test suite passes at the audited revision
controls.applies_when: The project has automated tests.
controls.verified_when: Imported CI or test-run evidence for the audited revision shows passing results.
controls.static_limits: Flight Check does not run project tests during an audit.

controls.title: Model-initiated actions are authorized server-side for the acting user, scoped, and confirmed when consequential
controls.applies_when: A model can call tools, functions, or APIs, or its output drives actions.
controls.verified_when: Tool execution checks the acting user's permissions independently of model output, tools are least-privilege, and consequential actions need confirmation.
controls.static_limits: Provider-side tool configuration outside the repository is not visible.

controls.title: Model context cannot leak data across users or tenants, and untrusted content cannot exfiltrate secrets through the model
controls.applies_when: A model processes user data or untrusted content.
controls.verified_when: Context assembly is scoped to the requesting principal and secrets are never placed in model context.
controls.static_limits: Provider data retention and training use depend on contracts and settings outside the repository.

controls.title: Model output is validated or escaped before rendering, storage, or execution
controls.applies_when: Model output is rendered, stored, or executed.
controls.verified_when: Output is treated as untrusted at each sink found.
controls.static_limits: None beyond general output-handling limits.

controls.title: Model usage has rate, size, or cost limits
controls.applies_when: Users can trigger model calls.
controls.verified_when: Per-user or global limits on model calls or tokens are present.
controls.static_limits: Provider-side spend limits are not visible.

controls.title: Interactive elements have accessible names, images have text alternatives, forms have associated labels and errors, and structure is semantic
controls.applies_when: The project has a user interface.
controls.verified_when: The UI code found provides names, labels, alternatives, and semantic structure for the components examined.
controls.static_limits: Contrast, focus order, and screen-reader behavior require runtime testing.

controls.title: Keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, and motion behavior has been tested
controls.applies_when: The project has a user interface.
controls.verified_when: Imported accessibility test results or automated accessibility tests in the repository cover the main flows.
controls.static_limits: Requires runtime testing evidence.

controls.title: Terms exist for a public service and address the topics the service's business model raises
controls.applies_when: The project offers a service to external users or customers.
controls.verified_when: Terms are present; topics such as liability limitation, warranty disclaimer, governing law, termination, and payment terms are addressed where the business model raises them. Adequacy and enforceability are for counsel.
controls.static_limits: Flight Check does not determine legal adequacy or enforceability.

controls.title: A governing-law and dispute-resolution decision is recorded and applied consistently
controls.applies_when: The project has terms or contracts with users or customers.
controls.verified_when: A governing-law decision appears and is consistent across documents.
controls.static_limits: Flight Check does not determine which jurisdiction is appropriate.

controls.title: Regulated data categories (for example health, payment card, children's, biometric data) are identified and handled with corresponding controls
controls.applies_when: The project may process regulated categories of data.
controls.verified_when: Code and documentation identify the categories and show corresponding controls; applicability determinations are for qualified professionals.
controls.static_limits: Organizational controls, contracts, and certifications are not visible.

controls.title: User-facing security, privacy, and product claims are supported by the implementation
controls.applies_when: Documentation, policies, UI text, or marketing material make claims about security, privacy, data handling, or product behavior.
controls.verified_when: Each claim examined is backed by implementation evidence; contradictions are reported as findings.
controls.static_limits: Claims about infrastructure outside the repository may be unverifiable.
